posts.title: Self-improving software is inevitable
posts.description: Production tells us exactly how to make our software better, we've just never had the tools to run this on auto-pilot.

posts.title: On-Call Is Now Theatre
posts.description: On-call was calibrated to the cost of waking up a human. That cost just went to zero. Self-operating software is coming, and your rotation is the last thing standing in its way.

posts.title: Slop Creep: The Great Enshittification of Software
posts.description: Coding agents didn't make poor engineers dangerous. They made them unstoppable.
